title: FOMC minutes — January 26–27, 2027 meeting (14:00 ET) — the missing entry in an otherwise complete minutes series, and it lands on VIX February settlement day
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, page's own 'Last Update: August 19, 2026') — the 2027 block lists 'January 26-27' as the first meeting, and the release date is derived as decision day + 21 days from the Fed's own published minutes history on the same page: 2026 Jan 27-28 → 'Released February 18, 2026'; Mar 17-18 → April 08; Apr 28-29 → May 20; Jun 16-17 → July 08; Jul 28-29 → August 19 — the +21-day rule reproduces 5 of 5 in 2026 and again on 2025 Jan 28-29 → February 19, 2025. Filed estimate because the date is DERIVED rather than listed (the Fed publishes minutes dates only after the fact), and because the Fed's own page states every 2027 meeting date is 'tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it'. Proposed by the never-assessed initial research of uk-cpi-2027-02-17, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED BY THE uk-cpi-2027-02-17 LANE, 2026-09-09. This calendar already carries ten fomc-minutes entries — 2026-10-07, 2026-11-18, 2026-12-30, 2027-05-19, 2027-06-30, 2027-08-18, 2027-10-06, 2027-11-17, 2027-12-29, 2028-02-16 — and every one of them is its meeting's decision day plus 21 days. The January 2027 meeting (fomc-2027-01-27, already on the calendar) is the one gap in that series, and its +21 lands on 2027-02-17. IT WAS ALREADY COMPUTED, JUST NEVER FILED: FT-vix-expiration-2027-11-17-1 names '2027-02-17' explicitly as one of 'the four upcoming collisions' between a minutes release and a VIX settlement, alongside 2026-11-18, 2027-08-18 and 2027-11-17 — three of which have calendar entries and this one does not. WHY IT MATTERS BEYOND COMPLETENESS. FT-vix-expiration-2027-02-17-2 exists precisely to be the CONTROL for two sibling FOMC-morning tests: it predicts the VIX final settlement (VRO, ~09:00 ET) prints above the same day's VIX cash close (16:00 ET) on a settlement morning 'carrying no FOMC'. A minutes release at 14:00 ET is not an FOMC decision, so it does not trigger that row's stated void clause — but it lands INSIDE the measurement window, between the 09:00 settlement and the 16:00 close it is compared against. The control day is not as clean as its designer had it, and that lane should decide whether to re-specify; it is not this lane's row to edit. Tiered MEDIUM to match the other fomc-minutes entries on this calendar rather than the LOW of the proposing event. Estimate widens caution only; promote once the 2026-12-09 meeting confirms the 2027 calendar and the Fed posts the release date.
